events.host: "{item}": {target} must attempt a challenge against the ability's owner.
events.zone: "{item}": {target} is in the area and must attempt a challenge.

trg.on: A zone trigger has no event: enter, start or end of turn ({path})
trg.per: "At most" is once per round or once per turn ({path})
trg.to: Zone trigger steps apply only to the creature in the area (to: target) ({path})
trg.empty: The zone trigger is empty: add steps or a challenge ({path})

ev.on: An event entry has no event from the list ({path})
ev.side: The event side is owner, roll target or origin ({path})
ev.sideTarget: "Roll target" exists only for rolls and spell casting ({path})
ev.afterUse: "After use" is yes or no, and only for the owner's own roll (attack, check, save, damage) ({path})
ev.empty: The event entry is empty: add steps or a challenge ({path})
ev.nearOn: The "in aura" side exists only for start of turn, end of turn and enter ({path})
ev.enter: Entering an aura is only for the "in the owner's aura" side ({path})
ev.nearZone: An "in aura" entry needs exactly one of: aura slug (aura) or range in feet (range > 0) ({path})
ev.nearOnly: Aura, range and "at most" exist only for the "in the owner's aura" side ({path})

cast.bad: Activation (cast): needs a spell (UUID), rank 1-10, DC as a number or level: high, attack as a number, frequency as once per N rounds/minutes/hours/days, requirement invested, equipped, held or none; the key (id) is unique ({path})

afflict.bad: Step "affliction": an object with the definition def and an optional stage number is required ({path})
afflict.def: Affliction definition: name, kind (poison, disease, curse), virulent is yes or no only, traits are slugs ({path})
afflict.save: Affliction definition: the save is Fortitude, Reflex or Will, DC is an integer from 1 (may be omitted: taken from the challenge) ({path})
afflict.stage: Affliction stage: integer from 1 to the stage count; stage fields are duration, damage, persistent, conditions, mods, text ({path})
afflict.dur: Affliction duration: integer from 1 and a unit — rounds, minutes, hours or days ({path})
afflict.damage: Stage damage: up to four entries with a dice formula and a damage type ({path})
afflict.persistent: Stage persistent damage: dice formula, damage type, DC is an integer from 1 ({path})
afflict.conditions: Stage conditions: up to six distinct ones, slug and a value from 1 to 10 ({path})
afflict.mods: Stage penalties: the same blocks as a step effect (up to four) ({path})
afflict.text: Stage text is a string of up to 600 characters ({path})
afflict.to: An affliction is applied to the target only (to: target) ({path})

sheet.eventNote: The rule's events (roll, damage, turn, effect) are edited in the Workshop; they are kept unchanged here.
sheet.castNote: The item's activations (cast a spell) are edited in the Workshop; they are kept unchanged here.

when.onEvent: On event · run by the GM
when.cast: Item activation · cast by whoever presses the button

trg.hint: Zone triggers: what happens to a creature that enters the area or starts or ends its turn in it. The challenge and steps work as in events.

on.turn-start: Starts its turn in the area
on.turn-end: Ends its turn in the area

story.onEvent: The rule fires on events. Each has its own condition, steps and challenge.
story.cast: The item casts a spell from the button on its own card. After that the spell's own rule takes over.

ev.hint: "Self" is the rule's owner. "Target" is the other party of the event: the roll's target, the roller, or whoever bears the effect.
ev.whenHint: A pf2e predicate: options separated by commas (all at once) or JSON. Outcome is outcome:success.
ev.afterUse: Only for the roll right after this item's card

side.near: in the owner's aura (enemy/ally — in the challenge)

ev.zoneAuraHint: Either the slug of a pf2e rules aura (frightful-aura) or range in feet from the owner

cast.hint: One entry is one activation ("You cast ..."). DC and rank can stay empty: they come from the owner and the spell. Drop a spell on the field or anywhere on the row.

why.equipped: The item must be worn or held.
why.noSpell: The activation spell is not in the world's compendia.

cast.noCaster: The owner has no spellcasting and the rule gives no DC: it cannot be cast.
cast.again: The activation limit is spent ("{name}"). Cast anyway?

affliction.ended: "{item}": the maximum duration on {target} has run out — the affliction ends.

apply.afflictionNoDC: "{name}": the affliction DC is unknown — not applied.
apply.afflictionTaken: "{name}": "{item}" is already active — a repeated exposure adds no stages (disease and curse).
